title: Sniffer Egg Fall Block
description: This Mod Allows you placing a Sniffer Egg On the Air can fall and damage any entities
body:
the sniffer eggs acts like an anvil and has the double of damage

it has a 17% of Creaking the Egg.
And the same for hatching the sniffer here (only for creative mode you can use the different states)

IT ONLY FALLS ON PLACING THE BLOCK so as not to limit its decorative use.
